concept: A correction becomes shared truth without erasing its history.

storyboard.frame: Fragmented state streams arrive as translucent record layers with distinct material depth.
The layers converge on one durable record; the current value becomes visually legible without generated text.
One value changes. The prior layer remains visible behind the corrected layer rather than disappearing.
The correction travels along every dependent path, then the composition settles into the opening frame.

start_state: Wide split-hero composition: several translucent archival record layers and fine state streams are spatially separated around an empty central registration plane.
end_state: The corrected durable record occupies that same central registration plane, its earlier value remains faintly visible behind it, and propagation pulses settle as new edge fragments enter in the exact opening geometry for a seamless loop.
palette: Warm paper #f6f3ea, deep ink #14201c, Neotoma teal #1f6f5c and #2f8a72, correction amber #8a5a10, restrained line #ddd6c4.
material: Archival glass, translucent vellum, engraved paper fibers, restrained volumetric dust, and precise luminous record paths. Photoreal material response without literal documents or readable text.
camera: Locked 4:3 frame with a slow controlled macro dolly and shallow layered parallax; no cuts, whip pans, handheld shake, or dramatic zoom.
art_direction: Realistic light, material, and camera treatment with an archival and temporal mood. Use Neotoma teal as the record signal. No generated text, product UI, or faces.
negative_constraints: no people, faces, hands, or avatars
no data-cloud, brain, database-cylinder, or generic AI iconography
no destructive overwrite or disappearing prior layer
no frenetic particles, glitch effects, camera cuts, or ambient decorative motion
poster_frame: A durable teal record in focus with the earlier translucent value still visible and dependent paths ready to receive the correction.
